title: Frappe ERPNext 6.18.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 6.18.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Payment Requests feature. This flaw allows authenticated users with the Accounts User role to read source documents they are not authorized to access by creating a Payment Request referencing another company's document and emailing its content.
